theme_archetype.rationale: For an e-commerce dashboard managing inventory and cross-platform synchronization (Bling to JohnDrop), the UI must prioritize clarity and authority. The 'E1 Twist' applies a 'Neo-Brutalist Utility' approach: 95% of the UI is monochrome, and color is strictly functional to guide actions (e.g., sync status, AI generation).

rules: Headings must use tight letter spacing (tracking-tight or tracking-tighter).
Technical data like SKUs, Product Codes, and EANs must use the Mono font.
Overlines and table headers must be uppercase + tiny + wide spacing.

spacing_layout.spacing_scale: Tailwind standard (p-2, p-4, p-6). Containers with borders must have internal padding.

dashboard_grid.span_logic: Summary widgets: col-span-3. Main chart/table: col-span-9.

spacing_layout.alignment_rules: Left-align all paragraphs, labels, and tabular data. Optical alignment for icons within buttons.
spacing_layout.borders: Expose the skeleton. Use grid borders ('Technical' look). Use sharp edges (rounded-none or rounded-sm [2px]). No soft rounded corners.

components.strategy: Shadcn UI heavily customized to remove the 'Vercel-look'. Flat backgrounds, sharp corners, 1px solid borders.

cards.style: Flat background (bg-white), 1px subtle border (border-[#E5E5E5]), rounded-none, NO shadow by default.
cards.hover: Slight lift (-translate-y-px), border color darkens to #A3A3A3, sharp crisp shadow (shadow-[2px_2px_0px_#0A0A0A]).

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-white rounded-none font-medium hover:bg-primary_hover transition-colors
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-default text-primary rounded-none hover:border-primary hover:text-primary transition-colors
buttons.ai_action: bg-white border-2 border-ai_sparkle text-ai_sparkle rounded-none hover:bg-ai_sparkle hover:text-white transition-all shadow-[2px_2px_0px_#FF4500]

inputs_and_forms.style: bg-secondary border-b-2 border-transparent hover:border-default focus:border-primary rounded-none focus:ring-0 px-4 py-2 transition-colors
inputs_and_forms.seo_title_input: Include a strict character counter visually attached to the input field. Turns red when > 60 characters.

tabs.style: Marketplace tabs (Amazon, Shopee, Kwai) must use sharp borders, with the active tab having a 2px top border matching the marketplace brand color.

tables.style: Dense data grids. border-collapse. Row hover state: bg-tertiary. Use sticky headers for large inventory lists.

motion_interactions.hover_states: All interactive elements must explicitly change text and background color on hover.
motion_interactions.focus_states: High contrast 2px ring or solid border color change.
motion_interactions.transitions: Use specific properties (e.g., transition: border-color 0.2s ease, background-color 0.2s ease). No 'transition-all' for grids.

visual_enhancers.icons: Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react) - Duotone weight for marketing/empty states, Regular weight for dense dashboard tables.
visual_enhancers.ai_generation_loader: ASCII art or retro-terminal cursor blinking effect to signal 'AI working' rather than a generic spinner.

surface_styles.header: Solid background (bg-white) with a hard 1px bottom border.
surface_styles.status_indicators: Small solid circles (6px) next to Mono text for Sync Status (e.g., Green for Synced, Red for Error).

login_background.description: Black and white abstract geometric architectural structure. Use as the right-side split screen background for the Login page.

empty_state_inventory.description: Logistics/calendar visual. Use at low opacity for empty states in the product or sync tabs.

product_mockup_1.description: Cosmetic skincare tube on white background. Use to populate the product mock data in the catalog/editor.

product_mockup_2.description: Toy shopping cart mockup. Use for product list mockup.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install specific font dependencies via Google Fonts (Work Sans, IBM Plex Sans, JetBrains Mono).
Build the dashboard layout with pure HTML/Tailwind classes leveraging CSS Grid (grid-cols-12 for main content).
For the Product SEO Editor: Implement Shadcn Tabs for the marketplace views (Amazon, Shopee, Kwai). Each tab must dynamically show required fields. Amazon tab requires exactly 6 bullet point inputs.

Implement a strict visual character counter for the SEO title (Max 60 chars) - it should turn Red and display a warning icon when exceeded. Do NOT include EAN/Brand fields in the title generator logic.
Auth screen must use a split-layout: Left side stark white minimal login form, Right side uses the 'login_background' image with a grayscale filter.
All components must strictly adhere to the 'rounded-none' or 'rounded-sm' rules. Remove all default Shadcn rounding (rounded-md/lg).
Do not use transparent headers. The top nav must have bg-white and border-b.
Use data-testid attributes on all buttons, tabs, and form inputs.
